# DappRadar DEX — Track DEX Activity, Tokens & Volume Reference

> Use DappRadar's DEX and token explorer to track decentralized-exchange activity, token prices, trading volume and rankings across many blockchains. Independent, informational, not affiliated with DappRadar. Does not execute trades.

## Key Facts
- DappRadar: dapp analytics platform tracking apps, tokens and activity across many chains
- DEX explorer: track volume, active traders, transactions and rankings for decentralized exchanges
- Token explorer: prices, market data and activity for ERC-20 and other tokens; verify by contract address
- Coverage: Ethereum, its layer-2 rollups and other layer-1 networks; varies by chain and dapp
- Data caveats: wash trading, thin liquidity, source differences and latency can distort figures
- RADAR: DappRadar ecosystem token (ERC-20 on Ethereum); not required to use analytics
- Analytics only — this resource does not execute trades
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by DappRadar
